Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description: Gluttony Combo is a lalalazy-branded fork of Wrath Combo. Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button - and then some. All upstream credit to Team Wrath / PunishXIV.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.338 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v1.0.4.337 (2026-11-09) [testing]
- **The AI decision layer is gone.** The Fight Brain's question side - the raidwide mitigation ask, the pre-pull plan reader (party finder text and the `/gluttony plan` note command), and the party-callout reader - has been removed from the plugin, together with its relay address setting and the two "Plan Reader"/"Callout Reader" switches. GluttonyCombo no longer asks any decision model anything, sends no snapshot anywhere, and keeps no relay URL: the only network path it still uses is the movement tap's `/move/ingest` upload, which records the movement profiles and never carried a decision.
- What stays is pure code and unchanged: the rotation and every combo, the Fight Brain forecast reads and `FB|forecast` lines, the countdown strip, the shadow cast-gate lines, the party-data shadow rules (`FB|party-mit`, `FB|pos-zone`), and the movement recorder and shadow move planner. The move planner's `MP|` decision lines keep their exact format and now always carry the code pick only.
- The shadow move planner no longer has its ask-side toggle; `/gluttony movelog` now switches the recorder and the planner together, and its status line reads two switches instead of three.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.336 (2026-11-09) [testing]
- **Saving a custom action to a hotbar while in PvP now writes the PvP layout.** The custom-action editor's hotbar save told the game the write was a normal-slot write regardless of the current content, so a save made while in PvP updated the regular hotbar set instead of the PvP one; the call now passes the content check (upstream's fix), so the PvP variant of the slot is the one written.
- **The action-replacing hook answers in the game's own yes/no shape.** The IsActionIdReplaceable detour and its delegate declared an unsigned 64-bit return where the game's callback uses a boolean, so the replace decision relied on 0/1 marshalling to land correctly; both signatures now match the native BOOL return (upstream's fix), and the early-return values read true/false instead of 1/0. No behavior change is intended - this removes a latent hook-contract mismatch.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.335 (2026-11-07) [testing]
- **AoE heals no longer fire back to back on a party that is at or near full HP.** Follow-up to 1.0.4.334: on a party whose bars all read full or nearly full, the auto-rotation kept pressing AoE heals - a bar just under 100% never counted as full (regen-tick oscillation and display rounding), and a heal that had just gone out did not stand the press path down while it landed. Two changes, shared by Astrologian, White Mage, Scholar and Sage. First, a member only counts as needing an AoE heal on a real deficit: a bar at or above 98% reads as full for both the one-button average and the auto-rotation's member count, so no threshold setting (including the 100 "disable this check" setting, and a target count of 0, which is now floored at 1) can make a full party eligible. Second, the auto-rotation presses one AoE heal at a time: after a press goes out, the next waits out that cast's flight plus a second for the heal to land and party HP to propagate, so a movement-cancelled cast is no longer re-issued every tick. Real damage is never starved - a party still under the threshold after the window heals again immediately. Single-target heals, raidwide pre-casts and the 1.0.4.334 out-of-range fix are unchanged; the manual one-button still heals when pressed.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.334 (2026-11-07) [testing]
- **Healer one-button AoE heals no longer trigger off party members the heal cannot reach.** The Astrologian, White Mage, Scholar and Sage one-button AoE heal rotations averaged the whole party's HP: a member standing outside the heal's radius kept the average under the threshold, so the rotation kept choosing AoE heals (Helios, Medica, Succor, Prognosis and their oGCD neighbours) that could never heal that member. The trigger now averages only the members inside the heal's own effect radius (15y for the Helios family), alive and targetable, so the rotation returns to damaging while nobody reachable needs healing, and heals again the moment the far member comes back into range. Single-target healing is untouched: a member returning to range is picked up by the single-target path exactly as before. Raidwide pre-casts and the auto-rotation's own cast gate are unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.333 (2026-11-06) [testing]
- **The movement recorder and the shadow move planner actually start now.** Every load of 1.0.4.328-1.0.4.332 killed them at startup: the tap installed itself before the settings existed and died on an error the moment the plugin loaded, so no movement was recorded at all in any session and nothing reached the movement database. The tap now installs after the settings load, the settings read can no longer fail that way, and if an install ever fails again it retries on the framework tick and on every zone change (a login is one) instead of staying dead for the whole session.
- **The movement relay address can no longer be lost to a blank setting.** A blank relay address now falls back to the shared LAN Jev relay, so recorded movement reaches the database without anyone typing /gluttony movelog relay first; the command still overrides the address. Before this build a blank address silently switched the uploads off.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Log only: nothing moves the character, nothing presses a button, never in PvP, off under AutoDuty. 1.0.4.328-1.0.4.332 collected no movement samples; this is the first build that can.
